title.fr: Mouvement d'une particule chargée dans un champ magnétique uniforme

sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with uniform B (dots or crosses) and a charged
particle entering perpendicular to B; trajectory closes into a
circle of radius R = mv/(|q|B). Student sets q, m, v, B; R updates
and the circle redraws. Experiment: 3 seeded target radii; student
picks B to match. Evaluate: circle hidden; only entry point, target
chord, and B-indicator shown; student submits B blind. Wrinkle:
sign of q flips rotation sense (horaire vs. anti-horaire).
